units.source_text: 从前队伍是通过颇有京都特色的窄路，有的人家还被彩车弄坏些什么，然而这也很有情趣。

en.t: In the past, the procession passed through narrow streets with a distinctly Kyoto character, and some houses would have things damaged by the festival floats; even so, that too had its own charm.

units.source_text: 据说在二楼可以要到粽子，如今则是撒粽子。

en.t: It is said that people on the second floor used to be able to ask for chimaki rice dumplings, whereas nowadays the dumplings are scattered out to the crowd.
